text: The praises of the man With ten languages of song was this book said: with nitzuakh, with niggun, with mizmor, with shir, with hallel, with t'fillah, with b'rakhah, with hoda'ah, with ashre, with hallelujah, corresponding to the ten persons who said it: Adam, Melchizedek, Abraham, Moses, David, Solomon, Asaph and the three sons of Korah. And they differ on Jeduthun: there are those who say he was a man as it is written in Chronicles (1 16:38), and there are those who say, Jeduthun that is in this book only refers to the laws and the judgments of the decrees which have gone over him and over Israel.

The praises of the man Les felicements in the foreign language; the contentment of man and his praises are these, that he did not go; for since he did not go, he did not stand; and since he did stand, he did not sit.
But in the Torah of God is his will
Here you learn that the seat of the insulters brings him to the wasting of Torah.
And in his Torah he shall meditate
In the beginning it is called the Torah of God; and from when he toiled in it, it is called his Torah.
He shall meditate
Every language of hegeh (meditation) is in the heart; like you say: (Psalm 19:14) and the meditation of my heart...
Planted
Plonté in the foreign language.
Streams
Ruyséys in the foreign language.
And its leaf will not wilt
Even its castaway is for a purpose. The chat of scholars [literally, students of wise ones] is for a purpose, and needs study.
Will not wilt
A language of withering; plestjjr in the foreign language.
As the chaff
A language of straw; come bale in the foreign language.
For this etc.
[This verse] is attached to the verse that follows.
Because God knows the path etc.

Because He knows the path of the righteous and it's before Him to recognize it constantly, and the path of the wicked is hated in His eyes and He transfers it from before Him, for this, there will not be a leg to stand on for the wicked for the Day of Judgement and for sinners to be written in the congregation of the righteous.
Will laugh... will ridicule... will speak
They serve the present tense.
Then He will speak to them
Like elehem (to them). And what is the speaking?
And I crowned My king
Why did you assemble, and I appointed for Myself this one to rule and to king on Zion, the mountain of My Holiness.
Ask of Me
Pray to Me at every time that you come to fight with your enemies.
You shall break them
You shall shatter them.
With a staff of iron
That is the sword.
You shall scatter them
You shall break them. And that is the language of niputz (carding) in all of scripture; earthenware that is broken into fine breakaways.
And now, kings, wise up
The prophets of Israel [are] men of mercy, and reprove the nations of the world to withdraw...
And rejoice with trembling
When that trembling will come, about which it is written (Isaiah 33)...
Many rise against me
Men who are great in Torah, great in wisdom, great in wealth, great in stature; such as Saul and "the children of the giant" (2 Samuel 21:16), Doeg and Ahitophel.
Say of my soul [literally, to my soul]
On my soul.
There is no salvation for him in God. Selah
Because he came on the wife of a man.
Have set
A language of desolation; gatiront in the foreign language. And there are those who say, שתו is like set; like: (Exodus 10:1) that I might set My signs.
To God the salvation etc.
Upon Him is to save His servants and His nation; and upon His nation it is imposed to bless and to give thanks to Him. Selah.
To the Nehiloth

Menahem interpreted concerning all of them: Nehiloth and Alamoth, Gittith, Jeduthun – they are all names of musical instruments; and the pleasantness of the Psalm was according to the song which is fitting to that instrument. And a haggadic midrash – there are those who explain Nehiloth – a language of heritage. And this is not the intent of the word. And the matter of the Psalm is also not speaking about heritage. And it is possible to interpret Nehiloth – troops; like: "swarm (nehil) of bees", (and like (Psalms 18:5): And floods of Belial, and its Targum is: And a group of guilty ones) – a prayer because of troops of enemies which come unto Israel; and the poet says this Psalm for all of Israel.
[In the] morning You shall hear my voice

In the morning I call to You on them; for it is a time of judgment for the evil, like it says (Psalm 101:8): In the mornings I will destroy all the wicked of the land; Be their arm in the mornings (Isaiah 33:2) ...
Boasters
The stupid. And in the language of Mishnah: The confused.
A man of blood and deceit
This is Amalek and his seed.
And I
I will come [into] Your House to give thanks to You in the abundance of Your loving-kindness that You...
Those observing me
Those that are eyeing me; who anticipate that I shall betray You and You will abandon me. Those observing me – like (Numbers 24:17): I shall observe him, but not near.
For there is no truth in his mouth
They look like lovers, and they are enemies.
Their inward part is a yawning gulf
Their thoughts are deceit.
An open grave is their throat
To swallow the toil of others like the grave that swallows the body.
They will make smooth
Words of smoothness.
By their counsels
That they counsel on Israel. –
And then – all those that take refuge in You shall rejoice.
And You shall shelter them
You shall protect and shelter them.
And they shall exult in You
When they will see that You will bless Your friends and Your lovers.
As with a shield
Which surrounds the three sides of a person.
Favor
Pleasure; apimat in the foreign language.
You shall encompass him
You shall surround him; like (1 Samuel 23:26): and Saul and his men compass David and his men.
